name: melink-sidecode
description: SideCode is one agent chat sidebar for VS Code and Open VSX hosts, driving Ollama Cloud, the OpenAI Codex CLI, and OpenCode Zen.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: SideCode works in an untrusted workspace, but the settings that decide where a credential is sent, which binary is spawned, and what the permission default is are read from your user settings only. These settings are ignored when they come from a workspace: melink.ollama.baseUrl, melink.ollama.opencode.path, melink.ollama.opencode.cliSource, melink.codex.path, melink.skills.zvecGrep.path, melink.skills.zvecGrep.cliSource, melink.skills.astGrep.path, melink.skills.astGrep.cliSource, melink.defaults.permissionLevel. The application scope of these settings is enforced by SideCode itself, so a workspace value never reaches them, trusted or not. Open the workspace in Restricted Mode to keep the workspace from changing anything at all.

commands.title: SideCode: Set OpenCode Zen API key
SideCode: Clear OpenCode Zen API key

melink.ollama.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL for the Ollama Cloud API. The token set via **SideCode: Set Ollama Cloud token** is sent as a bearer credential to this host. This setting is read from your user settings only, so a workspace cannot redirect the token to another host.

melink.ollama.defaultModel.description: Default Ollama Cloud model. Empty means the first model reported by the backend is used.

melink.opencode.defaultModel.description: Default OpenCode Zen model. Empty means the first model the app's catalog shows is used: the free list without a Zen API key, or the full live list with one. Free models work without a key; paid models require SideCode: Set OpenCode Zen API key.

melink.ollama.opencode.enabled.markdownDescription: Run Ollama Cloud turns through the **opencode** agentic runtime (tool execution, file edits, session resume) instead of the direct `/api/chat` streaming adapter. On by default. Turn it off to use the direct adapter and spawn no opencode process.

melink.ollama.opencode.path.description: Path to the opencode CLI executable used when melink.ollama.opencode.enabled is on and melink.ollama.opencode.cliSource is local. Resolved from PATH when it is a bare name. A relative path is refused, including the Windows drive-relative form (C:evil.exe), because it would run a file from the workspace. Ignored when cliSource is bundled. Read from your user settings only, so a workspace cannot choose the binary that runs.

enumDescriptions: Use the opencode CLI on this machine (path setting or PATH).
Use the SideCode-downloaded CLI in extension global storage. Install and Update fetch the official GitHub release into that folder; it survives closing VS Code.
melink.ollama.opencode.cliSource.markdownDescription: Where the opencode CLI comes from. **local** uses `melink.ollama.opencode.path`. **bundled** downloads into extension global storage and every turn uses that binary instead of the machine PATH. Read from your user settings only.

melink.ollama.opencode.zvecGrep.markdownDescription: Legacy. Prefer `melink.skills.zvecGrep`. Used only when the skills key is unset.

melink.codex.path.description: Path to the OpenAI Codex CLI executable. Resolved from PATH when it is a bare name. A relative path is refused, including the Windows drive-relative form (C:evil.exe), because it would run a file from the workspace. Read from your user settings only, so a workspace cannot choose the binary that runs.

melink.codex.defaultModel.description: Default model passed to the Codex CLI. Empty means the CLI default is used.

enumDescriptions: Read-only: Codex runs read-only; anything that would write is requested.
Default: workspace writes run in a sandbox; commands may request approval, though Codex still auto-approves some in-sandbox commands. Anything outside the sandbox is requested.
Unrestricted: no sandbox and no prompts. Selecting this requires an explicit confirmation.
melink.defaults.permissionLevel.description: Permission level used until you pick one in the chat. The picker choice is remembered for the next conversation. Unrestricted must be confirmed before it is applied. Read from your user settings only, so a workspace cannot raise the permission default.

enumDescriptions: Off: no extra check; stored approval rules decide as before.
Ask: a recognised destructive command always needs your decision, even when a stored rule matches.
Block: a recognised destructive command is refused without a decision card.
melink.safety.destructiveCommands.markdownDescription: What SideCode does when it recognises a destructive command (recursive delete, force push, hard reset, database drop, or a pattern from `melink.safety.destructivePatterns`). This check runs before stored approval rules, so an `Always allow` rule for `git` or `rm` cannot answer it silently. The reason names the risk and the bounded command; common password/token values are redacted, and no working directory, environment or secret-store values are included.

melink.safety.destructivePatterns.markdownDescription: Extra regular expressions (case-insensitive) that mark a command as destructive. An invalid or blank pattern is ignored. These patterns use the same **Ask**/**Block** action as the built-in checks.

enumDescriptions: Agent: the agent acts on the workspace.
Plan: the agent proposes a plan before acting.
Ask: the agent only answers questions.
melink.defaults.mode.description: Default mode for a new conversation. A per-conversation choice overrides it.

enumDescriptions: No app default: each model uses its own reported default level.
Off: do not reason.
Low: minimal reasoning.
Medium: balanced reasoning.
High: more reasoning.
Extra high: the model's maximum reasoning effort.
melink.defaults.thinking.description: App-level default thinking level. A per-model choice overrides it, and a model's own reported default overrides this when neither is set.

melink.defaults.dictationModel.description: Ollama or Codex model that cleans dictated speech into the message text. Stored as provider|model. It does not answer. Empty disables the microphone.

melink.context.includeInstructions.markdownDescription: Include instruction documents (`AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`) in the project context snapshot. A disabled category is never sent.

melink.context.includeShape.markdownDescription: Include project shape (language breakdown, directory tree, manifests) in the project context snapshot.

melink.context.includeEditorState.markdownDescription: Follow the active file and open editors. When off, no active-file path, language, or open-editor list is read or sent, and the composer strip stops naming a current file.

melink.context.includeSelection.markdownDescription: Quote the current selection in the project context snapshot. When off, the selected text is never read. Selected text is sent verbatim, so only enable this when the selection is safe to share.

melink.context.includeChangedFiles.markdownDescription: Include a changed-files notice in the per-turn context delta.

melink.context.maxBytes.markdownDescription: Overall byte cap for a rendered project-context snapshot. When the cap is reached, categories truncate in a documented order (open editors, then instruction documents, then the tree).

melink.context.repoMap.markdownDescription: Include a bounded per-turn symbol/import map built from the files the snapshot already accepted. Off by default. When on, definitions and imports are ranked against your message and dirty files; a failed, unavailable or over-budget map is a one-line marker, never a blocked turn.

melink.context.repoMapMaxFiles.markdownDescription: Maximum source files the repository map may read in one build. The build stops deterministically at the cap and says it was limited.

melink.context.repoMapMaxBytes.markdownDescription: Maximum bytes the repository map may read in one build.

melink.context.repoMapBuildMs.markdownDescription: Wall-clock budget in milliseconds for one repository-map build. A slow or never-resolving file read times out and is reported as limited.

melink.context.repoMapMaxChars.markdownDescription: Character cap for the rendered per-turn repository-map block.

melink.context.exclude.markdownDescription: Extra glob patterns excluded from the project context snapshot, on top of the built-in ignore set and `files.exclude`/`search.exclude`. An excluded path is never read, and a selection inside one is reported as excluded rather than quoted.

melink.review.diffReview.markdownDescription: Run an opt-in, read-only **diff review** after a turn changes files. It is advisory only: it never edits files, runs shell commands, asks for approvals, or keeps/rejects changes. The first pass is local and deterministic (it flags explicit paths the request named but the turn did not change); a prompt/runner seam is ready for a future model reviewer.

melink.review.checks.enabled.markdownDescription: Run post-turn checks after a turn that changed files, before the changes are kept. Checks never run in an untrusted workspace.

melink.review.checks.commands.markdownDescription: Explicit commands to run after a turn that changed files. Leave empty to auto-detect `typecheck` (or `lint`) and `test` from `package.json`; an explicitly saved empty list turns checks off. Auto-detection uses the manifest's `packageManager` and falls back to `npm`.

melink.review.checks.timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Per-check timeout in seconds. Values outside 5-600 are clamped. A timed-out check is killed and reported as timed out.

melink.skills.browserCodex.markdownDescription: Let **Codex** open a browser tab in the editor to check layout. On by default. When off, Codex conversations do not get browser tools.

melink.skills.browserOpencode.markdownDescription: Let **OpenCode** (Ollama agentic runtime) open a browser tab in the editor to check layout. On by default. When off, OpenCode turns do not get browser tools.

melink.skills.browser.markdownDescription: Legacy single switch. Used only when `melink.skills.browserCodex` / `browserOpencode` are unset. Prefer the per-provider settings.

melink.skills.zvecGrep.markdownDescription: Connect [zvec-grep](https://github.com/zvec-ai/zvec-grep) to OpenCode (local semantic + keyword + ripgrep search as an MCP tool). Turning it on installs `zg` when missing and writes an absolute-path MCP entry. Turning it off removes that entry and leaves the CLI installed.

enumDescriptions: Use zg on this machine (path setting or PATH / npm global).
Use the SideCode-managed install under extension global storage.
melink.skills.zvecGrep.cliSource.markdownDescription: Where the zvec-grep CLI comes from. Read from your user settings only.

melink.skills.zvecGrep.path.description: Path to the zg CLI when melink.skills.zvecGrep.cliSource is local. Ignored when bundled. A relative path is refused, including the Windows drive-relative form (C:evil.exe), because it would run a file from the workspace. Read from your user settings only, so a workspace cannot choose the binary that runs.

melink.skills.astGrep.markdownDescription: Connect [ast-grep](https://github.com/ast-grep/ast-grep) to OpenCode (syntax-aware structural search and rewrite via a SideCode MCP shim).

enumDescriptions: Use ast-grep on this machine (path setting or PATH).
Use the SideCode-downloaded CLI under extension global storage.
melink.skills.astGrep.cliSource.markdownDescription: Where the ast-grep CLI comes from. Read from your user settings only.

melink.skills.astGrep.path.description: Path to the ast-grep CLI when melink.skills.astGrep.cliSource is local. Ignored when bundled. A relative path is refused, including the Windows drive-relative form (C:evil.exe), because it would run a file from the workspace. Read from your user settings only, so a workspace cannot choose the binary that runs.
